properties.name: Phantom Photon
properties.description: Neon puzzle-action: you are a photon that can only move along walls. Swipe to slide, fly until you hit the next wall.

events.comment: MAIN MENU - photons fly across, a black hole bends/swallows them, juicy PLAY button -> LevelSelect. Source: src/menu_logic.js
LEVEL SELECT - chapter cards (swipe / arrows / keys), level nodes, progress from localStorage. ?unlock unlocks everything. Source: src/select_logic.js

PHANTOM PHOTON - you are a photon of light that can only move along walls.
Rules: swipe / arrow keys along a wall you touch -> you slide, fly straight off the end and stick to the next wall you hit. Ramps (violet) mirror your flight 90 degrees. Pink launch pads: TAP / Space kicks you straight away from them. Black holes bend your flight and swallow you if you get too close (respawn at your last wall).

events.name: Game (JavaScript): input, movement sim, levels, effects, camera, UI

events.comment: Source files: src/sim.js (movement rules, shared with src/solve.js) + src/game_logic.js. Levels: src/levels.json. Regenerate with src/rebuild.sh. Tuning constants are at the top of sim.js (speed, gravity, swallow radius).
